say.en: Ethanol is a drink and a fuel; dimethyl ether is a gas used in aerosol sprays. Both are C 2H 6O. The way the atoms are joined makes all the difference. In this lesson: Define isomerism.
Tell chain, position, functional group and metamerism apart.
Know the two kinds of stereoisomerism.

body.en: Isomers have the same molecular formula but different properties. *Structural* isomers differ in how atoms are connected. Chain isomers have different carbon skeletons (pentane, isopentane, neopentane). Position isomers differ in the position of a group (propan-1-ol and propan-2-ol). Functional group isomers have different functional groups (ethanol and methoxymethane). Metamers have different alkyl groups on either side of the functional group (diethyl ether and methyl propyl ether).

narration.en: Pentane, C₅H₁₂, can be built in three ways: a straight chain, one branch, or two branches on the same carbon. They have the same molecular formula but different carbon skeletons, so they are chain isomers. More branching makes the molecule more compact, with less surface for attraction, so the boiling point falls.
narration.kn: ಪೆಂಟೇನ್ C₅H₁₂ ಅನ್ನು ಮೂರು ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಚಿಸಬಹುದು: ನೇರ ಸರಪಳಿ, ಒಂದು ಕವಲು, ಅಥವಾ ಒಂದೇ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಕವಲು. ಅಣುಸೂತ್ರ ಒಂದೇ, ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಬೇರೆ: ಸರಪಳಿ ಸಮಾಂಗಿಗಳು. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕವಲು ಅಣುವನ್ನು ಸಾಂದ್ರಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಕುದಿಬಿಂದು ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Isomers share a molecular formula. Structural isomers differ in how the atoms are joined; stereoisomers differ only in arrangement in space.
Chain isomers of C5H12: pentane, isopentane and neopentane have different carbon skeletons.
Position isomers differ in where the group sits, like propan-1-ol and propan-2-ol. Functional isomers have different groups: ethanol and dimethyl ether are both C2H6O.
Restricted rotation about a double bond gives geometrical isomers. In cis-but-2-ene the methyl groups are on the same side; in trans, on opposite sides.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Write and name all structural isomers of C₅H₁₂.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Write and name all structural isomers of C 5H 12.
Straight chain: CH 3CH 2CH 2CH 2CH 3, pentane.
One branch: CH 3 2CHCH 2CH 3, 2-methylbutane.
Two branches on one carbon: CCH 3 4, 2,2-dimethylpropane.
No other skeleton is possible, so there are 3 chain isomers.
So the answer is 3 isomers: pentane, 2-methylbutane, 2,2-dimethylpropane.

problem.en: Find all structural isomers of C₄H₉Cl.

steps.en: Butane skeleton: Cl on C1 (1-chlorobutane) or C2 (2-chlorobutane).
Isobutane skeleton: Cl on a CH₃ (1-chloro-2-methylpropane) or on the central C (2-chloro-2-methylpropane).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find all structural isomers of C₄H₉Cl.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find all structural isomers of C 4H 9Cl.
Butane skeleton: Cl on C1 (1-chlorobutane) or C2 (2-chlorobutane).
Isobutane skeleton: Cl on a CH 3 (1-chloro-2-methylpropane) or on the central C (2-chloro-2-methylpropane).
Total equals 4.
So the answer is 4 isomers.
